Analysis.object: Obsessive passion mediated the relationship between both types of perfectionism and disordered eating. Harmonious passion mediated the relationship between self-oriented perfectionism and physical and psychological well-being.
The cross-sectional design did not allow us to make causal inferences.

Further research is deemed necessary to replicate the results of
this research and further extend our understanding of the psychological
processes involved in disordered eating and physical and psychological
well-being in a broader set of sports and participants.
